/*
 * This test is inspired by (and tests) PR#12. The interesting aspect of
 * this is the multiply in the parameter passed to module foo instance yak.
 */
`define ONE 1
`define TWO 2

module foo(in,out);
   parameter blah = 2;

   input     in;
   output    out;

   initial begin
      if (blah != 4) begin
	 $display("FAILED -- parameter override of blah failed: %d", blah);
	 $finish;
      end

      $display("PASSED");
   end

endmodule

module bar;

	foo #(`ONE * 2 + `TWO) yak (,);

endmodule
